verdict.reasoning: The printed page 225 (V-33) shows the centred, underlined heading 'GENERAL FORMAT FOR COBOL VERBS' above the S and RI WRITE formats. The transcription (page-225.md) carries the same words, underlined and in bold, in the same place. The heading is present, so nothing is missing; only the Markdown markup differs (bold instead of '##'). It is true that the specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md copies on earlier Verb Formats pages use '## <u>...</u>' (lines 8887-9620), and page 224 (line 9685) also uses bold. That is inconsistent formatting, but it changes no content or meaning of the standard. The task rules say a formatting-only difference is not a discrepancy. A heading-based outline is a tooling convenience, not spec content.
